subject: Budget range validation — PayBridge (pricing & procurement thresholds)
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna@paybridge.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: quick budget question after today's demo

Marissa — thanks again for the demo today. Quick follow up as we start internal sizing: can you confirm the unit economics you expect for hosted usage (ballpark $/1M tokens) and what monthly spend bands materially change pricing?

High-level numbers from our side: 20M user-chat tokens/month (short sessions, avg 120 tokens/response) + ~5M embedding tokens for search/upserts. We need to validate expected monthly spend and procurement thresholds (when does a PO vs contract review kick in).

Also: Jenna from our platform ops is cc'd — she'll own procurement questions.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Product
PayBridge
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@paybridge.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna@paybridge.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick budget question after today's demo

Hi Samir — great chatting earlier. Quick post-call recap and the budget bands we typically see for customers with your footprint.

Recap / asks:
- Monthly volume: you mentioned ~25M total tokens (20M chat + 5M embeddings). Confirm if that is sustained or a pilot spike.
- Target unit economics: what's your target $/1M tokens (ballpark) so I can map to hosted vs committed pricing.
- Procurement thresholds: who needs to sign for PO amounts >$X? Jenna, any constraints we should know about (PO min, legal reviews, SSO/SAML requirements)?

Redwood hosted pricing — ballpark bands (public reference; final pricing depends on model & commitment):
- 0–5M tokens/mo: $240 / 1M tokens
- 5–50M tokens/mo: $110 / 1M tokens
- 50M+ tokens/mo: $85 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- Committed (reserved) capacity and annual commitments can drop the 5–50M band to ~$75–$90 / 1M depending on term and model family.
- Embeddings generally price differently — for budgeting treat embeddings as ~0.5x the per-token rate of chat for typical open-model embeddings.
- We can provide a simple estimate PDF once you confirm sustained volume vs pilot.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm whether 25M is steady-state or pilot.
2) Confirm your target $/1M (if you have one).
3) Jenna, please share any procurement/PO thresholds and legal timelines; we'll attach an estimate and an initial MSAs/SSCs as needed.

I'll attach a draft estimate now and a short note on procurement triggers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna@paybridge.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick budget question after today's demo

Thanks Marissa — confirming numbers: 20M chat tokens + 5M embedding tokens is our expected steady-state for Q2; pilot next month will be ~5M chat tokens ramping up.

Target economics: we're looking for ~$100 / 1M tokens (blended) as an initial internal target. Procurement thresholds: any spend above $10k needs procurement approval and anything above $50k requires VP sign-off and legal review. PO process takes ~2 weeks once scope is finalized.

Can you send the estimate with those bands and a note on committed discounts? Also note: we need SOC2 + basic encryption-in-transit details for legal. Jenna will surface the security contacts.

—Samir
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@paybridge.com>
Cc: Jenna Li <jenna@paybridge.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick budget question after today's demo

Samir — thanks, that's helpful. Attached is a concise estimate (Redwood-Estimate-PayBridge-Q1.pdf) with three scenarios based on your steady-state 25M tokens/mo and the pilot ramp. Key points: 

- Blended hosted estimate @ list bands (no commitment): ~$2,750/mo (~$110 / 1M blended) for 25M tokens.
- Committed 12mo (discounted): estimated ~$1,875/mo (~$75 / 1M blended) with a 12-month commitment and 20% overage protection.
- Embeddings: modeled at 0.5x chat rate in the PDF.

Procurement notes (short):
- PO thresholds: <$10k — self-serve; $10k–$50k — procurement approval; >$50k — VP & legal review (per your note).
- Typical PO lead time: 10–14 business days after scope and SOW are agreed.
- For discounts tied to commitment we ask for an MSA + SOW; we can provide a redline-friendly MSA and SOC2 report on request.

Attachments included: Redwood-Estimate-PayBridge-Q1.pdf (pricing scenarios) and a short doc listing encryption + SOC2 references. If you want, Dylan (cc'd) can run a quick model-level sensitivity to show how moving to a quantized model or dedicated pool affects unit cost.

Next ask: Jenna — can you share the procurement contact and any specific doc routing (PO number format, AP email) so we can draft a sample SOW/PO? Also confirm timeline for pilot sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Jenna Li <jenna@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Samir Gupta <samir@paybridge.com>
Cc: procurement@paybridge.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick budget question after today's demo

Marissa — thanks for the estimate and clarity. A few quick procurement items: 
- AP/PO email: ap@paybridge.com
- PO format: include PR number and linked contract ID; procurement will only process POs >= $5k (anything below will be internal chargeback).
- Security: we need SOC2 Type II report and confirmation that data-in-transit is TLS1.2+ and keys can be rotated via our KMS. Can you share these docs?

Timeline: pilot budget approved for April (5M chat tokens); procurement will aim to issue a PO for the pilot by Apr 8. For sustained 25M volume we'll likely need the committed pricing conversation with finance in late April.

I'll put procurement contact on a separate thread if needed — copying procurement@paybridge.com now.

Best,
Jenna Li
Sr. Platform Operations Manager
PayBridge
